# Rejoice Events & Floral Studio — Best Event Management in Kottayam, Kerala

> Recognised as one of Kerala’s premium event planners, REJOICE EVENTS is based in Kottayam and serves clients across Kerala. We handle Wedding, Baptism, Holy Communion, Corporate Events, and all special occasions with timeless elegance and exceptional floral artistry. Rejoice Events also provides Funeral Services, handled with utmost compassion and dignity.

## Core Services & Interactive Checklists

Rejoice Events provides interactive, digital planning checklists that allow clients to customize every component of their celebration and generate an instant WhatsApp brief.

1. [Wedding Checklist & Planning](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/wedding.html): Full-service luxury Kerala wedding planning, mandap & stage decor, royal bridal entrance, banquet floral tablescapes, traditional nadhaswaram/chenda melam, live bands, cinematography, multi-course feast catering, and guest ushering.
2. [Baptism & Holy Communion Checklist](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/baptism.html): Sacred ceremony styling, altar floral arches, custom themed stage backdrops, cake table displays, return gifts, personalized photo corners, sound, and feast catering.
3. [Birthday & Milestone Jubilees Checklist](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/birthday.html): 1st birthday wonderlands, milestone 25th/50th/60th jubilees, custom 3D backdrops, balloon & floral art, illusionists, sound & lighting, dessert bars, and customized return favors.
4. [Funeral & Sacred Memorial Services](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/funeral.html): Compassionate 24/7 dignified funeral arrangements, solemn church altar cross florals, memorial arches, ambient candle styling, and sacred sound systems arranged with utmost respect.
5. [Custom Event Package Checklist](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/custom.html): Interactive custom event builder for engagements, anniversaries, housewarmings, and unique celebrations.
6. [Floral Studio](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/#floral-studio): In-house boutique floral atelier providing exotic fresh flower mandaps, handcrafted bridal bouquets, floral runners, and church altar arrangements.
7. [Privacy Policy](https://www.rejoiceeventsandflorals.com/privacy-policy.html): Complete privacy terms and client data confidentiality commitment.
